answer: Bounty bond blocks bulk fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits and posts a 30 walnut bounty on itself. Whoever proves two identities share one cipher claims the bounty; both bonds burn. An umber auditor pays only verified claims. 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 and fund 30,000 in bounties vs a 40,000 pool; each proven pair pays its hunter. Rented-key rings fail: one shared key forfeits every linked bond. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its bond.
